The main takeaway from our work is that
the conformational equilibrium is a key determinant of the signal transduction levels of GPCRs.
the efficacy of a ligand for a GPCR can be determined by the equilibrium between different conformations in the ligand-binding pocket.
GPCRs can be viewed as a molecular switch, where the equilibrium of the switch can be shifted to different states by ligands with different efficacy.
